final: SELECT SUM(i.Total) as sum_of_state_totals, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(c.State, 'NO_STATE')) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(c.State, 'NO_STATE')) * COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(c.State, 'NO_STATE')) as avg_invoices_per_state FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND i.InvoiceDate <= '2012-06-26 00:00:00' UNION ALL SELECT SUM(state_total), AVG(invoice_count) FROM (SELECT SUM(i.Total) as state_total, COUNT(*) as invoice_count FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND i.InvoiceDate <= '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY COALESCE(c.State, 'NO_STATE'))
